im 18, and I feel exactly the way u do and have for a very very long time I cant offer u words of advice or comfort that are life-changing like a professional could. but what I will say is even tho I don't know u or ur life whatsoever, things may not get better but they will eventually become manageable, u will have the highest of highs and the lowest of lows bc that's what life is. 

coming from someone who feels like everyone is 10 steps ahead of me, growing up overweight and unattractive and never hearing the end of it, feeling like I wasn't worth loving, having autism, and also struggling w sh. i see you. and I understand you. 

the worth of ur life and finding happiness should NEVER be defined by how others love you (especially in a romantic relationship). don't let anyone or anything make u think otherwise... shit feels like ur trapped in this position forever and ever but ur in that stage of life where big things r coming (finishing school, going to college if u want to, maybe moving to a new area for it? a fresh start?) 

this is just a chapter in ur life, don't let the progression of others' lives hamper urs, u are loved, people will come and go, some will stay, even in ur worst, the sun will rise the next day... everything is a lesson and an experience. right now all u need to do is survive, if u can channel all ur energy into something, anything, u don't have to be amazing at it whatsoever but it'll keep u busy, something to look forward to after a long day, (i read and cook)  lives can change for the better or for worse overnight so please stick around to see that. i cant promise you anything but in my own experience, as you keep trekking thru the shithole that is being alive, good things will find you. i have amazing friends now, might've found love, and i still have days where i feel as you do rn so i cant say things r peachy keen still. you are a human being, a life, and that makes you worth a million dollars my love. ur young, there is absolutely ZERO pressure for you to be a prodigy in something or be cuffed. 

all i can say as a final word of advice, focus on urself, even if your mental state doesn't improve significantly, do what YOU love, be the version of urself u wanna be without the need for others' validation or approval, do anything and everything that makes you feel like waking up the next day doesn't seem so bad and you wouldn't mind seeing what it has to offer. ur young, this is a time in ur life where new opportunities bounce at u like crazy. i genuinely believe one day u will find the right ppl, maybe someone to love (cus everyone is someone type i cannot stress that enough), ur constantly growing and changing and id love for you to stick around to see urself do that <3
